Tumanyi okukkiriza bwe kukola, n’ebiziyiza byakwo ebikulu bwe biri, ku nsonga y’okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Kirungi okwejjukiza nti obulabe bwe bumu buli mu kukozesa okukkiriza okututukuza nga mu kukkiriza okutuweesa obutuukirivu. Okukkiriza Katonda kukontana n’okwesiga ffe ffennyini: naddala okwesiga okwagala kwaffe n’okukola kwaffe. Okukkiriza kuziyizibwa buli kufuba kwe tukola okwekolera ekintu ffe ffennyini. Okukkiriza kutunuulira Katonda ng’akola, era kwewaayo eri amaanyi ge, nga bwe gabikkulibwa mu Kristo okuyita mu Mwoyo; kuleka Katonda okukola mu ffe okwagala n’okukola. Okukkiriza kuteekwa okukola; awatali bikolwa kuba kufu, era olw’ebikolwa kwokka mwe kutuukirizibwa; mu Kristo Yesu, nga Pawulo bw’agamba, tewali kigasa wabula ‘okukkiriza kukola olw’okwagala.’ Naye ebikolwa bino, okukkiriza mu kukola kwa Katonda bye kuleeta era bye kukola, byawukana nnyo ku bikolwa omukkiriza mw’atera okuteeka okufuba kwe kwonna, n’asanga ng’alemereddwa. Obulamu obw’obutukuvu obw’amazima, obulamu bw’abo abatukuziddwa mu Kristo, bulina ekikolo kyabwo n’amaanyi gaabwo mu kumanya okw’olubeerera nti tetulina maanyi n’akatono, mu kuwummula okw’omunda ennyo okwesiga okukola kw’amaanyi n’obulamu ebya Katonda, mu kwewaayo kwonna eri Omulokozi ow’okwagala, mu kukkiriza okukkiriza okuba nga si kintu, Ye alyoke abe byonna. Kiyinza okulabika nga tekisoboka kwawula oba okunnyonnyola enjawulo wakati w’okukola okuva mu ffe ffennyini n’okukola kwa Kristo okuyita mu kukkiriza: naye bwe tumanya obumanya nti enjawulo eyo weeri, bwe tuyiga obuteesiga ffe ffennyini, ne tusuubira Kristo okukola, Omwoyo Omutukuvu alituyingiza ne mu kyama kino ekya Mukama. Ebikolwa by’okukkiriza bye bikolwa bya Kristo. Era ng’okufuba bwe kuziyiza okukkiriza, bwe kityo n’okwegomba okulaba n’okuwulira bwe kukuziyiza. ‘Bw’onokkiriza onoolaba;’ Omwoyo Omutukuvu alissa akabonero ku kukkiriza kwaffe n’ebyo bye tuyitamu ebiva eri Katonda; tuliraba ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Naye ogwo mulimu gwe: ogwaffe kwe kukkiriza buli kaseera Yesu ng’okutukuzibwa kwaffe okumala byonna, mwe twatuukirizibwa mu maaso ga Katonda, ne bwe byonna birabika nga bya kizikiza era nga binnyogovu, ne bwe byonna obutonde bwaffe n’ebyo bye tuyitamu bye bijulira biba nga bikontana. Okwemulugunya ku butawulira kintu, ku bunafu oba obufu, tekutera kugasa: emmeeme egaana okwemalira ku yo yokka, oba ku bunafu bwayo oba ku maanyi g’omulabe, naye n’etunuulira kyokka Yesu ky’ali, n’ky’asuubizza okukola, yeeyo eriraba okukulaakulana mu butukuvu nga kutambula kwa ssanyu okuva mu buwanguzi okudda mu buwanguzi. ‘Mukama Katonda wammwe yennyini y’anaabalwaniriranga;’ ekirowoozo kino, ekiddibwamu emirundi mingi nga kyogera ku Isirayiri okutwala ensi ensuubize, ye mmere y’okukkiriza: mu bunafu bwe kumanyi, nga kuli mu maaso g’abalabe ab’amaanyi, kuyimba oluyimba lw’omuwanguzi. Katonda bw’alabika nga takola kye twamwesiga okukola, olwo nno kye kiseera ddala okukkiriza okumwenyumiririzaamu. Mpozzi tewali kintu kibikkula nnyo mpisa ntuufu ey’okukkiriza okusinga essanyu n’okutendereza. Osuubiza omwana ekirabo enkya: amangu ago agamba nti, Weebale, n’asanyuka. Okwebaza okw’essanyu bwe bukakafu nti ekisuubizo kyo kiyingidde ddala mu mutima gwe. Mukwano gwo akutegeeza ku busika obunene bw’akulekedde mu kiraamo kye: buyinza obutakutuukako okumala emyaka, naye ne kaakano bukusanyusa. Tumaze okulaba essanyu nga bwe liri ekitundu ekikulu eky’obutukuvu: naddala kitundu ky’obutukuvu obuva mu kukkiriza. Buli lwe ndaba ddala obulungi n’obujjuvu bw’enteekateeka ya Katonda, obutukuvu bwange mwe bubeera mu Yesu, era mwe nnina okumuleka okukola mu nze, omutima gwange gusaanidde okusituka mu kutendereza n’okwebaza. Mu kifo ky’okukkiriza ekirowoozo nti obulamu buno obw’obutukuvu olw’okukkiriza, ku nkomerero, buzibu nnyo okutuukako era bwetaagisa okwefiiriza obutasalako, tusaanidde okumutendereza ennyo olw’okubufuula obusoboka era obukakafu gye tuli: tusobola okuba abatukuvu, kubanga Yesu, Ow’amaanyi era Ow’okwagala, bwe butukuvu bwaffe. Okutendereza kujja kwolesa okukkiriza kwaffe; okutendereza kujja kukukakasa; okutendereza kujja kukunyweza. ‘Olwo ne bakkiriza ebigambo bye, bye yabasuubiza; ne bayimba nga bamutendereza.’ Okutendereza kujja kutusiba ku kukkiriza: tujja kulaba nti tulina ekintu kimu kyokka eky’okukola, okweyongera mu kukkiriza okwesiga bulijjo era okutendereza bulijjo. Mu kwegatta okulamu era okw’okwagala ne Yesu, okumusanyukira era okumutendereza obutayosa olw’ekyo ky’ali gye tuli, okukkiriza mwe kweyolekera, era mwe kufunira amaanyi g’obutukuvu. ‘Abatukuzibwa olw’okunzikiriza.’ Yee, ‘olw’okunzikiriza:’ ye Yesu omulamu yennyini eyeewaayo, Ye yennyini mu bugagga bwonna obw’Amaanyi ge n’Okwagala kwe, okuba kye kutunuulira okukkiriza kwaffe, amaanyi gaakwo n’obulamu bwakwo. Atugamba nti bwe tuba twagala okuba abatukuvu, bulijjo era mu byonna, tuteekwa okufaayo ku kintu kimu kyokka: okubeera bulijjo era ddala nga tujjudde okumukkiriza. Okukkiriza lye liiso ly’emmeeme: amaanyi ge tutegeerera okubeerawo kw’Oyo Atalabika, ng’ajja okutuwa Ye yennyini. Okukkiriza tekukoma ku kulaba, naye kweddiza era kukifuula kyakwo: ka tusirise ddala emmeeme zaffe eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe, azuukize era anyweze okukkiriza okwo, kwe yatuweerwa. Okukkiriza kwe kwewaayo: bwe twewaayo eri Yesu okumuleka akole omulimu gwe mu ffe, nga tumwewa abeeze obulamu bwe mu ffe era atuukirize by’ayagala mu ffe, tujja kumulaba nga yeewaayo yenna gye tuli, era nga atwefunira ddala. Bwe kityo okukkiriza kujja kuba maanyi: amaanyi ag’obuwulize okukola Katonda by’ayagala: ‘okukkiriza kwaffe okutukuvu ennyo,’ ‘okukkiriza abatukuvu kwe baaweebwa.’ Era tujja kutegeera ekyama ky’obutukuvu nga bwe kyangu eri abo abalina omutima ogumu: Yesu yekka. Tuli mu ye, Okutukuzibwa kwaffe: Ye yennyini bwe Butukuvu bwaffe; era obulamu obw’okumukkiriza, obumusembeza era obumulina, buteekwa okuba obulamu obw’obutukuvu. Yesu agamba nti, ‘Abatukuzibwa olw’okunzikiriza.’ Mubenga batukuvu, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu. Mukama Omwagalwa! Nate ndabye, nga nneewuunya era nga nkusinza, ky’oyagala okubeera gye ndi. Mu ggwe wennyini, ne mu bulamu obw’okussa ekimu naawe obutayosa, mwe nnina okufuukira omutukuvu. Mu bulamu obwangu obw’okwegatta naawe, obw’okwesiga n’okwagala, obw’okwewaayo n’okwewonga gy’oli, mw’ofuukira byonna gye ndi, n’ompa omugabo mu ggwe wennyini ne mu Butukuvu bwo. Mukama Yesu Omutendereze! Nzikiriza mu ggwe; yamba obutakkiriza bwange. Njatula obutakkiriza obukyasigaddewo, era nneesiga okubeerawo kwo okubuwangula n’okubugoba. Emmeeme yange yeeyongera okwezigula buli kiseera okulaba ennyo nga ggwe wennyini bw’oli Obulamu bwange n’Obutukuvu bwange. Ogaziya omutima gwange okukusanyukira ng’ebyange byonna, n’okukakasa nti ggwe wennyini oyingira n’ojjuza yeekaalu y’obulamu bwange n’ekitiibwa kyo. Onjigiriza okutegeera nti, ne bwe biba nga binafu, nga bya buntu era nga bimalamu amaanyi ebyo bye mpitamu, Omwoyo wo Omutukuvu ge maanyi g’okukkiriza kwange, ankulembera okukula mu kukwesiga okw’amaanyi era okugazi, ggwe mwe ndi omutukuvu. Ayi Omulokozi wange! Nkwata ekigambo kyo leero, ‘Abatukuzibwa olw’okunzikiriza,’ ng’okubikkulirwa okuggya okw’okwagala kwo n’ekigendererwa kyakwo gye ndi. Mu ggwe wennyini mwe muli Amaanyi g’obutukuvu bwange; mu ggwe mwe muli Amaanyi g’okukkiriza kwange. Erinnya lyo litenderezebwe kubanga nange ompadde ekifo mu abo b’oyogerako: ‘Abatukuzibwa olw’okunzikiriza.’ Amiina. 1. Ka tujjukire nti si kukkiriza kwokka okukolagana ne Kristo naddala olw’okutukuzibwa, wabula okukkiriza kwonna okulamu, okulina amaanyi okututukuza. Buli kintu ekisuula emmeeme yonna ku Yesu, ekireeta okwesiga okw’amaanyi era okwangu, ka kibe okugezesebwa kw’okukkiriza, oba okusaba okw’okukkiriza, oba omulimu gw’okukkiriza, kituyamba okuba abatukuvu, kubanga kituleeta mu kukwatagana okulamu n’Omutukuvu. 2. Olw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka Kristo n’Obutukuvu bwe mwe bibikkulirwa buli lunaku ne bifuuka byaffe ddala. Bwe kityo n’okukkiriza okumusembeza nakwo kuva eri Omwoyo. Weewaayo mu bwesimbu ne mu kwesiga eri okukola kwe. Totya, ng’alinga atasobola kukkiriza: olina ‘Omwoyo ow’okukkiriza’ munda mu ggwe: olina amaanyi okukkiriza. Era oyinza okusaba Katonda akunyweze nnyo n’Omwoyo we mu muntu ow’omunda, olw’okukkiriza okusembeza Kristo abeere mu ggwe awatali kusalako. 3. Okukkiriza kwe nnina kwenkana Omwoyo gwe nnina. Kale kino si kye nsinga okwetaaga, okubeera mu bulamu nga Omwoyo ye anfuga ddala? 4. Ng’eriiso bwe lisembeza mu kulaba, ne liganya ekiriteekeddwa mu maaso okulirekako akabonero, bwe kityo okukkiriza ke kabonero Katonda k’ateeka ku mmeeme bw’asembera. Okukkiriza kwa Ibulayimu tekwali kibala kya Katonda okumusemberera n’okwogera naye, akabonero Katonda ke yamuteekako? Ka tusirike tutunuulire ekyama kya Katonda ekya Kristo, obutukuvu bwaffe: Okubeerawo kwe, nga tukulindirira era nga tukusinza, kujja kuleeta okukkiriza. Kwe kugamba, Omwoyo ava gy’ali n’ayingira mu abo abamwekwatako, ye ajja okuba okukkiriza. 5. Obutukuvu olw’okukkiriza Yesu, si lwa kufuba kwo ggwe, Obufuzi bw’ekibi bubetentebwa olw’amaanyi g’ekisa kyokka,— Obutukuvu bwa Katonda yennyini munda mu ggwe, obulungi bwe ku kyenyi kyo,— Kino kye kinaaba okumasamasa kw’olugendo lwo, kino omugabo gwo ogw’omukisa kaakano. F. R. H. Olunaku olw’Ekkumi n’Omwenda.

fields.title: Obutukuvu n’Okuzuukira
fields.body_html:
‘Omwana wa Katonda, eyava mu zadde lya Dawudi mu mubiri, eyakakasibwa okuba Omwana wa Katonda mu maanyi, mu Mwoyo ow’obutukuvu, olw’okuzuukira kw’abafu.’—Abaruumi 1:4.

Ebigambo bino byogera ku kuzaalibwa kwa Kristo emirundi ebiri. Mu mubiri, yava mu zadde lya Dawudi. Mu Mwoyo, ye mubereberye eyasooka okuzuukira mu bafu. Nga bwe yali Omwana wa Dawudi olw’okuzaalibwa kwe mu mubiri, bw’atyo bwe yakakasibwa okuba Omwana wa Katonda mu maanyi olw’okuzaalibwa kwe okw’okuzuukira mu Mwoyo ow’obutukuvu. Ng’obulamu bwe yafuna mu kuzaalibwa kwe okusooka bwe bwali obulamu obw’omu mubiri n’obunafu bwagwo, bwe kityo obulamu obuggya bwe yafuna mu kuzuukira bwali bulamu mu maanyi g’Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu.

Ekigambo “Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu” kya njawulo. Ekigambo ekikozesebwa wano si kye kya bulijjo eky’Obutukuvu bwa Katonda, nga mu Abaebbulaniya 12:10, ekyogera ku butukuvu ng’engeri y’ekintu mu ndowooza obuzzi, wabula kigambo kirala (era ekikozesebwa mu 2 Abakkolinso 7:1 ne 1 Basessaloniika 3:13) ekyogera ku butukuvu nga bukola, ng’empisa ey’olubeerera—obutukuvu obweyolekera mu bulamu obwa bulijjo. Pawulo yakozesa ekigambo kino kubanga yayagala okuggumiza ekirowoozo nti okuzuukira kwa Kristo kwali kibala ddala eky’obulamu obwo obw’obutukuvu n’okwetukuza, obwatuuka ku ntikko yaabwo mu kufa kwe. Gwali mwoyo gw’obulamu obw’obutukuvu bwe yali abaddemu, era mu maanyi gaagwo mwe yazuukirizibwa. Atuyigiriza nti obulamu obwo n’okufa okwo eby’okwetukuza—nga mu ebyo byokka mwe kuyimiridde okutukuzibwa kwaffe—bye byali ekikolo n’omusingi gw’okuzuukira kwe, n’okulangirira kwakwo nti ye Mwana wa Katonda mu maanyi, omubereberye eyasooka okuzuukira mu bafu. Okuzuukira kye kyali ekibala Obulamu obwo obw’Obutukuvu kye bwabala.

Bwe kityo Obulamu obw’Obutukuvu bufuuka bwa bonna abagabana ku kuzuukira. Obulamu obw’Okuzuukira n’Omwoyo ow’Obutukuvu tebyawukana. Kristo yeetukuza mu kufa, ffe kennyini tulyoke tutukuzibwe mu mazima: bwe yazuukizibwa mu bafu olw’Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu, Omwoyo oyo ow’obutukuvu n’akakasibwa okuba amaanyi g’Obulamu obw’Okuzuukira, n’Obulamu obw’Okuzuukira ne bukakasibwa okuba Obulamu obw’Obutukuvu.

Ng’omukkiriza, olina omugabo mu Bulamu buno obw’Okuzuukira. Wazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri ‘olw’okuzuukira kwa Yesu Kristo mu bafu.’ ‘Wazuukirira awamu ne Kristo.’ Olagiddwa ‘okwerowooza okuba omulamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu.’ Naye obulamu obwo busobola okukola n’amaanyi kasita onoonya okubumanya, okwewaayo gye buli, n’okubuleka bukutwale ddala era bukufuge. Era bwe kiba nga bulina okukola ekyo, ekimu ku bintu ebisinga obukulu by’olina okutegeera kye kino: nga Kristo bwe yazuukizibwa olw’Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu, bwe kityo Omwoyo w’obutukuvu obwo bwennyini alina okuba mu ggwe akabonero n’amaanyi g’obulamu bwo. Fuba okumanya Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu n’okuba naye, nga bwe yalabikira mu bulamu bwa Mukama wo.

Kale kyali mu ki? Ekyama kyakyo, nga bwe tubuuliddwa, kyali kino: ‘Nzuuno nzize okukola by’oyagala.’ ‘Twatukuzibwa olw’okwagala kwe,’ nga Kristo bwe yakutuukiriza, ‘omubiri gwa Yesu Kristo bwe gwaweebwayo omulundi ogumu.’ Kuno kwe kwali okwetukuza kwa Kristo, mu bulamu ne mu kufa; kino Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu kye yakola mu ye; kino Omwoyo oyo yennyini, Omwoyo ow’obulamu mu Kristo Yesu, ky’anaakola mu ffe: obulamu obubeera mu kwagala kwa Katonda bwe bulamu obw’obutukuvu. Fuba nnyo okutegeera kino bulungi. Kristo yajja okubikkula obutukuvu obw’amazima bwe bwandibadde mu mbeera z’obulamu bw’omuntu n’obunafu bwe. Yajja okubutuukiriza ku lulwo, alyoke abukuwe olw’Omwoyo we. Bw’otobutegeera na magezi era n’otobukkiriza na mutima gwo gwonna, Omwoyo tayinza kubukola mu ggwe. Kale fuba n’omutima gwo gwonna okubukwata: okwagala kwa Katonda okukkirizibwa awatali kubuusabuusa ge maanyi g’obutukuvu.

Wano okugezaako kwonna okuba omutukuvu nga Kristo bw’ali omutukuvu, wamu n’Obutukuvu bwe era mu bwo, we kulina okutandikira. Bangi banoonya okukoppa ebitundu ebimu eby’obulamu oba eby’ekifaananyi kya Kristo, naye ne balemererwa nnyo mu birala. Tebalabanga nti okwegaana Yesu kw’atuyitira kitegeeza ddala okwegaana wennyini, mu makulu amajjuvu ag’ekigambo ekyo. Tewali na kimu kirina kukolebwa olw’okwagala kw’omuntu ku bubwe: Yesu, nga bwe yakolanga okwagala kwa Kitaawe kwokka, y’alina okufuga, so si nnaffe. ‘Okuyimirira ng’atuukiridde era ng’anywedde mu byonna Katonda by’ayagala’ kirina okuba ekigendererwa, okusaba n’essuubi ly’omuyigirizwa. Tewali nsonga ya kutya nti tekisoboka kumanya Kitaffe by’ayagala mu buli kintu. ‘Buli ayagala okukola Katonda by’ayagala, ategeera.’ Kitaffe tajja kuleka mwana amwagala nga tamanyi by’ayagala. Okwewaayo eri Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu, eri Yesu n’obufuzi bw’obulamu bwe obutukuvu, bwe kunaagenda kweyongera okuba okwangu, ekibi n’okwagala kw’omuntu ku bubwe bijja kulabika, okutegeera okw’omwoyo kujja kuggulwawo, n’etteeka eriwandiikiddwa munda mu ffe lijja kusomeka era litegeerekeke. Tewali nsonga ya kutya nti tekisoboka kukola Kitaffe by’ayagala bwe biba nga bimanyiddwa. Ennaku y’okulemererwa n’ekibi bw’emala okusindika omukkiriza mu bumanyirivu obwogerwako mu Abaruumi 7, era ekigambo nti, ‘Mu nze mu muntu ow’omunda njagala nnyo okugondera amateeka ga Katonda,’ ne kikakasa obwesimbu bwakyo mu kukaaba nti, ‘Nga ndi muntu munaku!’ okununulibwa kulituuka okuyita mu Yesu Kristo. Omwoyo takoma ku kutusobozesa kwagala kyokka, naye n’okukola; omukkiriza we yandisobodde okwemulugunya obwemulugunya nti, ‘Ne bwe njagala okukola ekirungi, tewali kirungi kye nkola,’ Omwoyo amuwa amaanyi n’oluyimba: ‘Kubanga etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo Yesu, lyannunula okuva mu tteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa.’

Mu kukkiriza kuno, nti kisoboka okumanya n’okukola Katonda by’ayagala mu byonna, twala okuva gy’ali—oyo yekka mw’oli omutukuvu—ekigambo kino ng’omusingi gw’obulamu bwo: ‘Nzuuno nzize okukola by’oyagala.’ Gwe musingi gw’obulamu obw’okuzuukira: awatali gwo Yesu teyandizuukiziddwa. Gwe musingi gw’obulamu obuggya mu ggwe. Gukkirize; gusome; gutegeere; gutuukirize mu bikolwa. Abakkiriza bangi bakizudde nti ebigambo ebimu ebyangu eby’okwewaayo, ebyoleka ekigendererwa eky’okukola Katonda by’ayagala mu buli kintu, bibayingizza mu ssanyu ne mu maanyi g’obulamu obw’okuzuukira bye baali tebamanyi. Okwagala kwa Katonda kwe kwolesebwa okujjuvu okw’okutuukirira kwe okw’empisa, Obutukuvu bwe obw’Obwakatonda. Okutwala ekifo kyo wakati mu kwagala okwo, okukutambuliramu, okusitulibwa n’okuwanirirwa nakwo—ago ge gaali amaanyi g’obulamu obwo obwa Yesu, okufa bwe kutaayinza kunyweza, obwateekwa okubutuka mu kitiibwa ky’okuzuukira. Kye kyali eri Yesu, kye kiriba eri ffe.

Obutukuvu bwe Bulamu: eno y’engeri esinga obwangu ey’okwogera amazima ebigambo byaffe bye bituyigiriza. Tewayinza kubaawo butukuvu okutuusa ng’obulamu obuggya busimbiddwa. Obulamu obuggya tebuyinza kukula n’okubutuka mu maanyi g’okuzuukira, tebuyinza kubala bibala, okuggyako nga bukula mu butukuvu. Omukkiriza bw’aba ng’akyabeera mu bulamu obutabuddwatabuddwa—ekitundu mu mubiri n’ekitundu mu mwoyo, ng’alimu ekitundu ky’okwagala kwe ku bubwe n’ekitundu kya Kristo—anoonyeza bwereere obutukuvu. Obulamu Obuggya bwe bulamu obutukuvu: okubutegeera mu bujjuvu mu kukkiriza, n’okubwewaayo mu bujjuvu mu mpisa, bye binaaba oluguudo olunene olw’obutukuvu. Yesu yabeera mulamu, n’afa, n’azuukira okututegekera obutonde obuggya, bwe tulina okufuna buli lunaku mu kugondera kw’okukkiriza: twambala ‘omuntu omuggya, eyatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda mu butuukirivu ne mu kutukuzibwa okw’amazima.’ Obulamu obw’omunda, obukwekeddwa wamu ne Kristo mu Katonda, era obukwekeddwa mu buziba bw’omunda mwennyini mu ffe, bwe bunaakkirizibwa, ne bulindirirwa, ne twewaayo gye buli, bujja kweyoleka mu bulungi bwonna obw’obutukuvu.

Waliwo n’ekisingawo. Obulamu buno tebufaanana ng’obulamu obw’obutonde, omusingi ogutalaba era ogutamanya, ogutuukiriza ekigendererwa kyagwo nga tegwesalidde, nga gugondera etteeka ly’obutonde bwagwo awatali kuwakanya. Waliwo Omwoyo ow’obulamu mu Kristo Yesu—Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu—Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe ng’Omuntu ow’Obwakatonda, ayingira mu kussa ekimu naffe, era atutwala mu kussa ekimu ne Kristo Omulamu. Kino kye kijjuza obulamu bwaffe essuubi n’essanyu. Omulokozi eyazuukira yassiza Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku bayigirizwa be: Omwoyo aleeta Oyo eyazuukira ku kisaawe, mu mitima gyaffe, ng’omukwano gwaffe ddala, ng’Omukulembeze Omulamu era Atuwa amaanyi. Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu ye Mwoyo wa Kristo Omulamu, kwe Kubeerawo kwe, era ge Maanyi ge. Yesu yagamba ku Mwoyo nti, ‘mmwe mumumanyi.’ Kale ekyetaago kyaffe ekisinga obukulu si kwe kumanya Omwoyo Omutukuvu oyo, Omwoyo wa Kristo, ow’Obutukuvu bwe n’obwaffe? Tuyinza tutya okuba ‘abatambulira mu Mwoyo’ n’okugoberera bw’atukulembera, nga tetumumanyi, wadde eddoboozi lye, wadde ekkubo lye?

Ka tuyige essomo erimu eddala okuva mu bigambo byaffe. Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu abutuka mu maanyi g’okuzuukira ng’ava mu ntaana y’omubiri n’ey’okwagala kw’omuntu ku bubwe. Tulina okukkiriza okufa eri omubiri, okufa eri ffe ffennyini n’okwagala kwaffe n’okukola kwaffe, ng’ekifo mwe kuzaalirwa okumanya kwaffe okw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu. Mu buli kulwanagana n’ekibi, mu buli kukozesa kukkiriza oba kusaba, tulina okuyingira mu kufa kwa Yesu, okufa eri ffe ffennyini, era nga abo aboogera nti, ‘tetusobola kulowooza kintu kyonna ku lwaffe ffekka,’ mu kukkiriza okukkakkamu tulindirire Omwoyo wa Kristo okukola omulimu gwe. Omwoyo ajja kukola, ng’akunyweza n’amaanyi mangi mu muntu ow’omunda, era ng’azimba mu ggwe yeekaalu entukuvu eri Mukama. Era ekiseera kirituuka—bwe kiba nga tekinnakutuukako—era kiyinza okuba nga kiri kumpi okusinga bw’oyinza okuguma okusuubira, Kristo okubeera mu mutima gwo olw’okukkiriza ng’obimanyi ddala, okubikkulirwa kwe okujjuvu n’okutuuzibwa kwe ku ntebe ng’omufuzi era omukuumi w’omutima n’obulamu, lwe biriba nga bifuuse bumanyirivu bwo ku bubwo. Mu Mwoyo ow’obutukuvu, olw’okuzuukira mu bafu, Omwana wa Katonda alikakasibwa mu maanyi mu bwakabaka obuli mu ggwe.

Mubenga batukuvu, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu.

Ayi Mukama Katonda Omutukuvu Ennyo! Tukutendereza nti wazuukiza Omwana wo mu bafu n’omuwa ekitiibwa, okukkiriza kwaffe n’essuubi lyaffe biryoke bibe mu ggwe. Wafuula okuzuukira kwe amaanyi g’obulamu obutaggwaawo mu ffe, era kaakano, nga bwe yazuukizibwa, naffe tusobola okutambulira mu bulamu obuggya. Nga Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu bwe yabeeranga era n’akolera mu ye, bw’atyo abeera era akolera mu ffe, n’afuuka mu ffe Omwoyo ow’obulamu.

Ayi Katonda! tukwegayiridde otuukirize omulimu gwo mu batukuvu bo. Bawe okutegeera okw’ebuziba okw’okuyitibwa okutukuvu kw’obayise mu Kristo, Oyo eyazuukira. Wa bonna okukkiriza Omwoyo w’obulamu bwe ku nsi—okusanyukira okwagala kwa Katonda—okuba omwoyo gw’obulamu bwabwe. Abo abatannakikkiriza mu bujjuvu baleetebwe okukikola, era mu kukkiriza amaanyi g’obulamu obuggya boogere nti, Nzikiriza okwagala kwa Katonda okuba etteeka lyange lyokka. Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu abeerenga omwoyo gw’obulamu bwabwe!

Kitaffe! tukwegayiridde, leka Kristo bw’atyo, mu kumanya okweyongera buli kiseera amaanyi g’okuzuukira kwe, abikkulibwe mu mitima gyaffe ng’Omwana wa Katonda, Mukama era Omufuzi munda mu ffe. Obulamu bwe obw’omunda mu ffe bulungamye obulamu bwonna obw’ebweru, bwe kityo mu maka ne mu bantu, mu birowoozo, mu bigambo ne mu bikolwa, mu ddiini ne mu mirimu, obulamu bwe bwakaayakanenga okuva mu ffe mu bulungi bw’obutukuvu. Amiina.

1. Ebyawandiikibwa bitunuulira okuzuukira mu ngeri bbiri ez’enjawulo. Mu ngeri emu, kwe kutuwa eddembe ku bulamu obuggya, ensibuko y’okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwaffe. (Abaruumi 4:25, 1 Abakkolinso 15:17.) Mu ngeri endala kwe kuzaalibwa kwaffe omulundi ogwokubiri, amaanyi g’obulamu obuggya agakolera mu ffe, ensibuko y’okutukuzibwa kwaffe. (Abaruumi 6:4; 1 Peetero 1:3.) Okusonyiyibwa n’obutukuvu tebyawukana; birina ensibuko emu, okwegatta ne Kristo Omulamu Eyazuukira.

2. Omukisa abayigirizwa gwe baafuna olw’okuba ne Kristo Eyazuukira gwali guno: Oyo gwe baalowooza nti afudde, yajja n’abeebikkulira. Kristo mulamu okwebikkulira ggwe nange; mulindirire, mwesige olw’ekyo. Ajja kwebikkula gy’oli ng’okutukuzibwa kwo. Kakasa nti oli naye nga wuwo ddala ow’omulamu, era olwo olina Obutukuvu bwe.

3. Obulamu bwa Kristo bwe butukuvu bwa Kristo. Ensonga lwaki emirundi mingi tulemererwa mu kunoonya obutukuvu eri nti obulamu obukadde—omubiri—mu maanyi gaabwo bwokka, bunoonya obutukuvu ng’ekyambalo ekirungi eky’okwambala n’okuyingira nakyo mu ggulu. Obulamu bwa Kristo busituka okuva mu kufa eri ffe ffennyini okwa buli lunaku.

4. Okufa bwe tutyo, okubeera abalamu bwe tutyo mu Kristo, okuba abatukuvu—tuyinza tutya okukituukako? Byonna bijja ‘mu Mwoyo ow’obutukuvu.’ Beera n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu munda mu ggwe. Yogera buli lunaku nti, ‘Nzikiriza Omwoyo Omutukuvu.’

5. Omutukuvu mu Kristo. Kristo bw’abeera mu ffe, era endowooza ye, nga bwe yeeyoleka mu bigambo bye ne mu mirimu gye ku nsi, n’eyingira n’ejjuza okwagala kwaffe n’okutegeera kwaffe okw’omunda, olwo okwegatta kwaffe naye ne kufuuka nga bwe yakutegeka okuba. Omwoyo w’empisa ye entukuvu, Omwoyo w’obutukuvu bwe, y’alina okuba mu ffe.


Olunaku olw’Amakumi Abiri.
fields.body_text: ‘Omwana wa Katonda, eyava mu zadde lya Dawudi mu mubiri, eyakakasibwa okuba Omwana wa Katonda mu maanyi, mu Mwoyo ow’obutukuvu, olw’okuzuukira kw’abafu.’—Abaruumi 1:4. Ebigambo bino byogera ku kuzaalibwa kwa Kristo emirundi ebiri. Mu mubiri, yava mu zadde lya Dawudi. Mu Mwoyo, ye mubereberye eyasooka okuzuukira mu bafu. Nga bwe yali Omwana wa Dawudi olw’okuzaalibwa kwe mu mubiri, bw’atyo bwe yakakasibwa okuba Omwana wa Katonda mu maanyi olw’okuzaalibwa kwe okw’okuzuukira mu Mwoyo ow’obutukuvu. Ng’obulamu bwe yafuna mu kuzaalibwa kwe okusooka bwe bwali obulamu obw’omu mubiri n’obunafu bwagwo, bwe kityo obulamu obuggya bwe yafuna mu kuzuukira bwali bulamu mu maanyi g’Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu. Ekigambo “Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu” kya njawulo. Ekigambo ekikozesebwa wano si kye kya bulijjo eky’Obutukuvu bwa Katonda, nga mu Abaebbulaniya 12:10, ekyogera ku butukuvu ng’engeri y’ekintu mu ndowooza obuzzi, wabula kigambo kirala (era ekikozesebwa mu 2 Abakkolinso 7:1 ne 1 Basessaloniika 3:13) ekyogera ku butukuvu nga bukola, ng’empisa ey’olubeerera—obutukuvu obweyolekera mu bulamu obwa bulijjo. Pawulo yakozesa ekigambo kino kubanga yayagala okuggumiza ekirowoozo nti okuzuukira kwa Kristo kwali kibala ddala eky’obulamu obwo obw’obutukuvu n’okwetukuza, obwatuuka ku ntikko yaabwo mu kufa kwe. Gwali mwoyo gw’obulamu obw’obutukuvu bwe yali abaddemu, era mu maanyi gaagwo mwe yazuukirizibwa. Atuyigiriza nti obulamu obwo n’okufa okwo eby’okwetukuza—nga mu ebyo byokka mwe kuyimiridde okutukuzibwa kwaffe—bye byali ekikolo n’omusingi gw’okuzuukira kwe, n’okulangirira kwakwo nti ye Mwana wa Katonda mu maanyi, omubereberye eyasooka okuzuukira mu bafu. Okuzuukira kye kyali ekibala Obulamu obwo obw’Obutukuvu kye bwabala. Bwe kityo Obulamu obw’Obutukuvu bufuuka bwa bonna abagabana ku kuzuukira. Obulamu obw’Okuzuukira n’Omwoyo ow’Obutukuvu tebyawukana. Kristo yeetukuza mu kufa, ffe kennyini tulyoke tutukuzibwe mu mazima: bwe yazuukizibwa mu bafu olw’Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu, Omwoyo oyo ow’obutukuvu n’akakasibwa okuba amaanyi g’Obulamu obw’Okuzuukira, n’Obulamu obw’Okuzuukira ne bukakasibwa okuba Obulamu obw’Obutukuvu. Ng’omukkiriza, olina omugabo mu Bulamu buno obw’Okuzuukira. Wazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri ‘olw’okuzuukira kwa Yesu Kristo mu bafu.’ ‘Wazuukirira awamu ne Kristo.’ Olagiddwa ‘okwerowooza okuba omulamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu.’ Naye obulamu obwo busobola okukola n’amaanyi kasita onoonya okubumanya, okwewaayo gye buli, n’okubuleka bukutwale ddala era bukufuge. Era bwe kiba nga bulina okukola ekyo, ekimu ku bintu ebisinga obukulu by’olina okutegeera kye kino: nga Kristo bwe yazuukizibwa olw’Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu, bwe kityo Omwoyo w’obutukuvu obwo bwennyini alina okuba mu ggwe akabonero n’amaanyi g’obulamu bwo. Fuba okumanya Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu n’okuba naye, nga bwe yalabikira mu bulamu bwa Mukama wo. Kale kyali mu ki? Ekyama kyakyo, nga bwe tubuuliddwa, kyali kino: ‘Nzuuno nzize okukola by’oyagala.’ ‘Twatukuzibwa olw’okwagala kwe,’ nga Kristo bwe yakutuukiriza, ‘omubiri gwa Yesu Kristo bwe gwaweebwayo omulundi ogumu.’ Kuno kwe kwali okwetukuza kwa Kristo, mu bulamu ne mu kufa; kino Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu kye yakola mu ye; kino Omwoyo oyo yennyini, Omwoyo ow’obulamu mu Kristo Yesu, ky’anaakola mu ffe: obulamu obubeera mu kwagala kwa Katonda bwe bulamu obw’obutukuvu. Fuba nnyo okutegeera kino bulungi. Kristo yajja okubikkula obutukuvu obw’amazima bwe bwandibadde mu mbeera z’obulamu bw’omuntu n’obunafu bwe. Yajja okubutuukiriza ku lulwo, alyoke abukuwe olw’Omwoyo we. Bw’otobutegeera na magezi era n’otobukkiriza na mutima gwo gwonna, Omwoyo tayinza kubukola mu ggwe. Kale fuba n’omutima gwo gwonna okubukwata: okwagala kwa Katonda okukkirizibwa awatali kubuusabuusa ge maanyi g’obutukuvu. Wano okugezaako kwonna okuba omutukuvu nga Kristo bw’ali omutukuvu, wamu n’Obutukuvu bwe era mu bwo, we kulina okutandikira. Bangi banoonya okukoppa ebitundu ebimu eby’obulamu oba eby’ekifaananyi kya Kristo, naye ne balemererwa nnyo mu birala. Tebalabanga nti okwegaana Yesu kw’atuyitira kitegeeza ddala okwegaana wennyini, mu makulu amajjuvu ag’ekigambo ekyo. Tewali na kimu kirina kukolebwa olw’okwagala kw’omuntu ku bubwe: Yesu, nga bwe yakolanga okwagala kwa Kitaawe kwokka, y’alina okufuga, so si nnaffe. ‘Okuyimirira ng’atuukiridde era ng’anywedde mu byonna Katonda by’ayagala’ kirina okuba ekigendererwa, okusaba n’essuubi ly’omuyigirizwa. Tewali nsonga ya kutya nti tekisoboka kumanya Kitaffe by’ayagala mu buli kintu. ‘Buli ayagala okukola Katonda by’ayagala, ategeera.’ Kitaffe tajja kuleka mwana amwagala nga tamanyi by’ayagala. Okwewaayo eri Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu, eri Yesu n’obufuzi bw’obulamu bwe obutukuvu, bwe kunaagenda kweyongera okuba okwangu, ekibi n’okwagala kw’omuntu ku bubwe bijja kulabika, okutegeera okw’omwoyo kujja kuggulwawo, n’etteeka eriwandiikiddwa munda mu ffe lijja kusomeka era litegeerekeke. Tewali nsonga ya kutya nti tekisoboka kukola Kitaffe by’ayagala bwe biba nga bimanyiddwa. Ennaku y’okulemererwa n’ekibi bw’emala okusindika omukkiriza mu bumanyirivu obwogerwako mu Abaruumi 7, era ekigambo nti, ‘Mu nze mu muntu ow’omunda njagala nnyo okugondera amateeka ga Katonda,’ ne kikakasa obwesimbu bwakyo mu kukaaba nti, ‘Nga ndi muntu munaku!’ okununulibwa kulituuka okuyita mu Yesu Kristo. Omwoyo takoma ku kutusobozesa kwagala kyokka, naye n’okukola; omukkiriza we yandisobodde okwemulugunya obwemulugunya nti, ‘Ne bwe njagala okukola ekirungi, tewali kirungi kye nkola,’ Omwoyo amuwa amaanyi n’oluyimba: ‘Kubanga etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo Yesu, lyannunula okuva mu tteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa.’ Mu kukkiriza kuno, nti kisoboka okumanya n’okukola Katonda by’ayagala mu byonna, twala okuva gy’ali—oyo yekka mw’oli omutukuvu—ekigambo kino ng’omusingi gw’obulamu bwo: ‘Nzuuno nzize okukola by’oyagala.’ Gwe musingi gw’obulamu obw’okuzuukira: awatali gwo Yesu teyandizuukiziddwa. Gwe musingi gw’obulamu obuggya mu ggwe. Gukkirize; gusome; gutegeere; gutuukirize mu bikolwa. Abakkiriza bangi bakizudde nti ebigambo ebimu ebyangu eby’okwewaayo, ebyoleka ekigendererwa eky’okukola Katonda by’ayagala mu buli kintu, bibayingizza mu ssanyu ne mu maanyi g’obulamu obw’okuzuukira bye baali tebamanyi. Okwagala kwa Katonda kwe kwolesebwa okujjuvu okw’okutuukirira kwe okw’empisa, Obutukuvu bwe obw’Obwakatonda. Okutwala ekifo kyo wakati mu kwagala okwo, okukutambuliramu, okusitulibwa n’okuwanirirwa nakwo—ago ge gaali amaanyi g’obulamu obwo obwa Yesu, okufa bwe kutaayinza kunyweza, obwateekwa okubutuka mu kitiibwa ky’okuzuukira. Waliwo n’ekisingawo. Kristo bw’abeera mu ffe, era endowooza ye, nga bwe yeeyoleka mu bigambo bye ne mu mirimu gye ku nsi, n’eyingira n’ejjuza okwagala kwaffe n’okutegeera kwaffe okw’omunda, olwo okwegatta kwaffe naye ne kufuuka nga bwe yakutegeka okuba. Omwoyo w’empisa ye entukuvu, Omwoyo w’obutukuvu bwe, y’alina okuba mu ffe. Olunaku olw’Amakumi Abiri.

fields.title: Obutukuvu n’Eddembe
fields.body_html:
‘Noolwekyo mwasumululwa okuva mu kibi, ne mufuuka baddu ba butuukirivu: bwe mutyo muweeyo ebitundu byammwe eby’omubiri okuba abaddu b’obutuukirivu, nga mweweerayo ddala eri Katonda, mube batukuvu. Naye kaakano obanga mwasumululwa mu kibi, ne mufuuka baddu ba Katonda, ebivaamu bibatuusa ku kutukuzibwa, n’enkomerero bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo.’—Abaruumi 6:18-19, 22.

‘eddembe lye tulina mu Kristo Yesu.’—Abaggalatiya 2:4.

‘Kale nga Kristo bwe yatufuula ab’eddembe, bwe mutyo munywerere mu ddembe eryo muleme kusibwa nate mu kikoligo ky’obuddu.’—Abaggalatiya 5:1.

Tewali kintu kye tuyinza kuba nakyo ekisinga eddembe omuwendo n’obulungi obutagerageranyizika. Tewali kintu kizzaamu muntu maanyi era kimugulumiza okusinga lyo; era ku luuyi olulala, tewali kintu kimumalamu maanyi era kimutoowaza okusinga obuddu. Obuddu bunyaga omuntu ekyo ekimufuula omuntu ddala: obuyinza okwesalirawo, okwekolera, okubeera n’okukola ky’ayagala.

Ekibi buddu: kwe kufugibwa obuyinza obugwira obwatuwangula, era emirundi mingi obutukaka okuweereza nga tetwagala n’akatono. Okununulibwa kwa Kristo kutuzzaayo eddembe lyaffe era kutusumulula okuva mu buyinza bw’ekibi. Bwe tuba ab’okubeera ddala mu bulamu ng’abanunule, tetwetaaga kutunuulira mulimu gwokka Kristo gwe yakola okututuusa ku kununulibwa kwaffe, wabula twetaaga n’okukkiriza n’okutegeerera ddala eddembe Kristo lye yatufuula ab’eddembe nga bwe lijjuvu, nga bwe lyesigika, era nga bwe litaliiko kkomo. Ebibala ebituusa ku kutukuzibwa tubifuna nga ‘tunywerera mu ddembe lyaffe mu Kristo Yesu’ kyokka.

Kyewuunyisa nti ekigambo mutukuvu kirabika mirundi mitono nnyo mu kuwoza okunene okw’Ebbaluwa eri Abaruumi, era nti mu ssuula 6, gye kikozesebwa emirundi ebiri mu bigambo ‘ku kutukuzibwa,’ kiteekebwawo mu bulambulukufu ng’ekigendererwa n’ekibala ekituukibwako mu bulamu obw’obutuukirivu. Ebigambo ‘ku kutukuzibwa’ ebyogerwa emirundi ebiri, ebiraga ekivaamu ekirina okufunibwa, bikulemberwa ebigambo ebyogerwa emirundi ebiri nti ‘mwasumululwa okuva mu kibi, ne mufuuka baddu ba butuukirivu.’ Kino kituyigiriza nti okusumululwa okuva mu buyinza bw’ekibi n’okwewaayo okuweereza obutuukirivu si bye butukuvu byennyini, wabula lye kkubo lyokka erikakafu eributuusaako. Okutegeera okw’amazima n’okuyingirira ddala eddembe lyaffe okuva mu kibi mu Kristo tebiyinza kubulawo mu bulamu obw’obutukuvu. Isirayiri bwe yasumululwa okuva ku Falaawo, Katonda n’alyoka atandika okweyoleka ng’Omutukuvu: era bwe tumanya nti ffe ‘twasumululwa okuva mu kibi,’ ne tununulibwa mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe bonna, lwe tuliweereza Katonda mu butuukirivu ne mu butukuvu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe.

Ebigambo bino, ‘mwasumululwa okuva mu kibi’: okubitegeera obulungi, tulina okwekuuma ensobi ey’emirundi ebiri. Tetulina kubikendeeza ne tubiwa amakulu amatono, wadde okubiyingizaamu amakulu amangi okusinga Omwoyo Omutukuvu ge yagenderera wano. Pawulo tayogera ku kubalirwa, wadde ku kintu omuntu ky’awulira. Tetulina kukikomya ku kusumululwa okuva mu kikolimo oba mu kibonerezo ky’ekibi. Ebigambo ebikyetoolodde biraga nti ayogera, si ku mbeera yaffe mu maaso g’omulamuzi, wabula ku kintu eky’amazima eky’omwoyo: okubeera kwaffe mu kwegatta okulamu ne Kristo mu kufa kwe ne mu kuzuukira kwe, era bwe tutyo okuggibwa ddala wansi w’obufuzi oba obuyinza bw’ekibi. ‘Ekibi tekiribafuga.’ Era tannayogera ku kintu ekiwulirwa, nti tuwulira nga tuli ba ddembe okuva mu kibi kyonna. Ayogera ku kintu ekinene ekiriwo ddala: Kristo okutununula olw’enkomerero okuva mu buyinza ekibi bwe kyalina okutukaka okukola bye kyagala n’emirimu gyakyo; era atukubiriza, mu kukkiriza ekintu kino eky’ekitalo, okugaana n’obuvumu okuwuliriza ebiragiro oba okukema kw’ekibi. Okumanya eddembe lye tulina mu Kristo, okusumululwa kwaffe okuva mu bufuzi n’obuyinza bw’ekibi, lye kkubo ery’okulifuula ekintu kye tulaba mu bulamu bwaffe.

Mu biseera eby’edda, Abatuluki oba Abawalabu bwe baafuulanga Abakristaayo abaddu emirundi mingi, ensimbi nnyingi zaasasulwanga okununula abo abaali mu buddu. Naye kyabaawo emirundi egisukka mu gumu, ewala munda mu nsi y’abaddu, abaanunulibwa obutawulira ku mawulire ago; bakama baabwe baasanyukanga nnyo okubakisa. Abalala nabo baawulira amawulire, naye baali bamaze okumanyiira obuddu bwabwe, ne batasobola kwekunkumula kufuba kutuuka ku lubalama lw’ennyanja. Obugayaavu oba okuggwamu essuubi ne bibakuumira mu buddu; tebaasobola kukkiriza nti bandisobodde okutuuka emirembe mu nsi ey’eddembe. Ensimbi ez’okubanunula zaali zisasuddwa; mu mazima baali ba ddembe; naye mu bulamu bwabwe, olw’obutamanya oba olw’obutaba na buvumu, baali bakyali mu buddu. Okununulibwa kwa Kristo kumalirawo ddala ekibi n’obuyinza obw’amateeka bwe kyalina ku ffe,—kubanga ‘amaanyi g’ekibi gava mu mateeka,’—ne kiba nti mu bikolwa ddala, mu mazima agasingayo obuziba, ekibi tekirina buyinza kutukaka kukigondera. Kisobola okutufuga lwokka nga tukikkirizza okuddamu okufuga, nga tweweerayo nate okuba abaddu baakyo. Setaani akola kyonna ky’asobola okukuuma abakkiriza mu butamanya bwa ddembe lino lyabwe nga bwe lijjuvu okuva mu buddu bwe. Era olw’okuba abakkiriza bamativu nnyo n’ebirowoozo byabwe bo bennyini ku makulu g’okununulibwa, ne beegomba katono era ne basaba katono okukulaba n’okukufuna mu bujjuvu bwakwo obw’okununulibwa n’omukisa, okumanya kwabwe mu bulamu eddembe okuva mu kibi gye liyinza okutuukira kye kiva kunafuye bwe kutyo. ‘buli Omwoyo wa Mukama w’abeera, wabaawo eddembe.’ Eddembe lino lifuuka lyaffe ku bw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, olw’ekitangaala kye n’okuluŋŋamya kwe munda mu ffe, bwe tubirindirira n’obwetoowaze ne tubigondera.

Mu ssuula ey’omukaaga Pawulo ayogera ku ddembe okuva mu kibi, ne mu ssuula 7 (nny. 3, 4, 6) ku ddembe okuva mu mateeka, nti byombi byaffe mu Kristo ne mu kwegatta naye. Mu ssuula 8 (nny. 2) ayogera ku ddembe lino ng’eryafuuka eryaffe mu bulamu bwe tuyitamu. Agamba nti, ‘etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo Yesu, lyannunula okuva mu tteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa.’ Eddembe eriri eryaffe mu Kristo lirina okufuuka eryaffe ku bwaffe, mu kulyetwalira n’okulinyumirwa, ku bw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Eky’okubiri kyesigamye ku kisooka: okukkiriza gye kukoma okujjula, okutegeera gye kukoma okulongooka, okwenyumiriza mu Kristo Yesu ne mu ddembe lye yatufuula ab’eddembe gye kukoma okuwangula, n’okuyingira mu ddembe ery’ekitiibwa ery’abaana ba Katonda gye kukoma okwanguwa n’okujjula. Nga eddembe bwe liri mu Kristo yekka, bwe kityo Omwoyo wa Kristo yekka y’alifuula eryaffe mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, era y’atukuuma nga tubeera omwo: ‘etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo Yesu, lyannunula okuva mu tteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa.’ ‘buli Omwoyo wa Mukama w’abeera, wabaawo eddembe.’ Omwoyo bw’atubikkulira Yesu nga ye Mukama era Mukulu waffe, Mukulu waffe omuggya, oyo yekka alina obuyinza ku ffe, n’atuluŋŋamya okwewaayo, okuwaayo ebitundu byaffe, n’okuwaayo obulamu bwaffe bwonna okuweereza Katonda mu Kristo, okukkiriza kwaffe mu ddembe okuva mu kibi kufuuka ekintu kye tumanyi era kye tulaba. Bw’akkiriza nti okununulibwa kujjuvu, omusibe afuluma nga ‘ow’eddembe owa Mukama.’ Kaakano amanyi nti ekibi tekikyalina buyinza, wadde akaseera akamu, okumulagira okukigondera. Kiyinza okugezaako okukakasa obuyinza bwakyo obw’edda; kiyinza okwogera mu ddoboozi ery’obuyinza; kiyinza okututiisa ne tugonda; naye obuyinza ku ffe tekirina n’akatono, okuggyako nga ffe, nga twerabidde eddembe lyaffe, tugondera okukema kwakyo, ne tukiwa ffe bennyini obuyinza.

Tuli ba ddembe aba Mukama. ‘Tulina eddembe lyaffe mu Kristo Yesu.’ Mu Abaruumi 7 Pawulo annyonnyola okulwana okw’entiisa okw’emmeeme ekyagezaako okutuukiriza amateeka, naye n’eyeesanga nga teyeesobola n’akatono; ng’etundiddwa wansi w’ekibi, omusibe era omuddu, nga terina ddembe kukola omutima gwonna bye gwegomba. Naye Omwoyo bw’atwala ekifo ky’amateeka, okwemulugunya nti, ‘Nga ndi muntu munaku!’ kukyuka ne kufuuka oluyimba olw’obuwanguzi: ‘Katonda yeebazibwe mu Yesu Kristo; etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu lyannunula.’

Okwemulugunya okutabalika okw’amaanyi agatamala okukola Katonda by’ayagala, okw’okufuba okutavaamu kantu n’essuubi eryamenyeka, n’okw’okulemererwa obutayosa, kuddamu mu ngeri nkumi na nkumi okwemulugunya kw’omusibe nti, ‘Nga ndi muntu munaku!’ Katonda yeebazibwe! Waliwo okununulibwa. ‘Kale nga Kristo bwe yatufuula ab’eddembe, bwe mutyo munywerere mu ddembe eryo muleme kusibwa nate mu kikoligo ky’obuddu.’ Setaani bulijjo anoonya okututeekako nate ekikoligo, oba eky’ekibi oba eky’amateeka, okuzaala nate omwoyo ogw’obuddu, ng’ekibi oba amateeka n’ebyo bye biragira birina obuyinza ku ffe mu ngeri emu oba endala. Si bwe kiri: temukkiriza kusibwa nate; munywerere mu ddembe Kristo lye yabafuula ab’eddembe. Ka tuwulirize obubaka buno: ‘mwasumululwa okuva mu kibi, ne mufuuka baddu ba butuukirivu; bwe mutyo muweeyo ebitundu byammwe eby’omubiri okuba abaddu b’obutuukirivu, mube batukuvu.’ ‘mwasumululwa mu kibi, ne mufuuka baddu ba Katonda, ebivaamu bibatuusa ku kutukuzibwa.’ Okuba omutukuvu, olina okuba ow’eddembe, ow’eddembe ddala ddala; ow’eddembe Yesu akufuge, akuluŋŋamye; ow’eddembe Omwoyo Omutukuvu akukozese nga bw’ayagala, akufuuweemu omukka gwe, akole omulimu gwe ogw’ekyama, omuteefu, naye ogw’amaanyi, olyoke okule okutuuka mu ddembe lyonna Yesu lye yakuwangulira. Yeekaalu teyandisobodde kutukuzibwa olwa Katonda okugibeeramu, okuggyako nga teriiko mukama mulala yenna era nga tekozesebwa mulimu mulala gwonna, ebe yiye yekka n’okumuweereza kwokka. Yeekaalu ey’omunda ey’omutima gwaffe teyinza kutukuzibwa ddala mu bujjuvu, okuggyako nga tuli ba ddembe okuva ku buli mukama omulala na buli buyinza, okuva ku buli kikoligo ky’obuddu, oba ky’okutya, oba ky’okubuusabuusa, Omwoyo we alyoke atuluŋŋamye mu ddembe erituukiridde eribala ekibala ky’obutukuvu obw’amazima.

Bwe mwasumululwa okuva mu kibi, ne mufuuka baddu ba butuukirivu, mulina ebibala byammwe ebituusa ku butukuvu, n’enkomerero bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo. Eddembe, Obutuukirivu, Obutukuvu—gano ge madaala mu kkubo erigenda eri ekitiibwa ekijja. Gye tukoma okuyingira mu buziba n’okukkiriza mu ddembe lyaffe lye tulina mu Kristo, gye tukoma okuwaayo ebitundu byaffe eri Katonda n’essanyu n’obuvumu ng’ebikozesebwa eby’obutuukirivu. Katonda ye Kitaffe, gwe tusanyukira okukola by’ayagala, era okumuweereza lye ddembe erituukiridde. Omununuzi ye Mukama waffe, okwagala gwe kutusiba gy’ali mu buwulize obw’okweyagalira. Eddembe si kubeera awatali tteeka: ‘twalokolebwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe, tulyoke tumuweereze mu butuukirivu ne mu butukuvu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe.’

Eddembe kye kisaanyizo ky’obutuukirivu; n’obutuukirivu nabwo kye kisaanyizo ky’obutukuvu. Okukola Katonda by’ayagala kutuyingiza mu kussa kimu okwo, mu kukwatagana kw’omutima ne Katonda yennyini, omuva ekifaananyi ky’Okubeerawo kwa Katonda ekyakaayakana, kwe kugamba Obutukuvu. Bwe tusumululwa okuva mu kibi, ne tufuulibwa abaddu b’obutuukirivu era aba Katonda, tulina ebibala byaffe ebituusa ku butukuvu, n’enkomerero—ekibala ky’obutukuvu, bwe kyengera, kifuuka ensigo y’—obulamu obutaggwaawo.

Mubenga batukuvu, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu.


Ai Katonda ow’ekitiibwa ekisingirayo ddala! Nkwegayirira ozibule amaaso gange ndabe eddembe lino ery’ekitalo Kristo lye yanfuula ow’eddembe. Ka nnyingire mu bujjuvu mu kigambo kyo, nti ekibi tekiriba na buyinza ku nze kubanga sifugibwa mateeka wabula ekisa. Ka mmanye eddembe lyange lye nnina mu Kristo Yesu, era nnywerere omwo.

Kitaffe! Okukuweereza lye ddembe erituukiridde: kino nakyo kimbikkulire. Ggwe oli wa Ddembe atalina kkomo, era by’oyagala tebiriiko kkomo okuggyako eryo okutuukirira kwabyo kwennyini lye kwateekawo. Era otuyita okuyingira mu by’oyagala, tulyoke tubeere ba ddembe nga ggwe bw’oli. Ai Katonda wange! Ndaga obulungi bw’ebyo by’oyagala, nga bwe binsumulula okuva mu nze kennyini n’okuva mu kibi, era bibeere omukisa gwange gwokka. Okuweereza obutuukirivu kubeere gye ndi essanyu n’amaanyi, nga kubala ebibala ebituusa ku kutukuzibwa, nga kunnyingiza mu Butukuvu bwo.

Mukama Yesu Omutendereze! Omununuzi wange era Eddembe lyange, ndi wuwo. Nneewaayo eri by’oyagala, nneme kumanya kye njagala okuggyako ky’oyagala. Mukama wange! Ggwe, era ggwe wekka, gwe njagala okuweereza. Eddembe lyange liri mu ggwe! Beera Mukuumi wange. Siyinza kuyimirira wadde akaseera akamu nga siri mu ggwe. Mu ggwe nsobola okunywerera: mu ggwe mwe nteeka obwesige bwange.

Ai Katonda Omutukuvu ennyo! Nga ndi mwana wo ow’eddembe, omuwulize, era akwagala, ojja kunfuula omutukuvu. Amiina.

1. Eddembe bwe buyinza okukola awatali kiziyiza ekyo obutonde bwaffe kye butusindiikiriza okukola. Mu Kristo omwana wa Katonda wa ddembe okuva ku buli buyinza obuyinza okumuziyiza okukola ng’etteeka ly’obutonde bwe obuggya bwe liragira.

2. Eddembe lino liva mu kukkiriza (Abaggalatiya 5:5-6). Olw’okukkiriza Kristo nnyingira mu lyo, era nnyimirira mu lyo.

3. Eddembe lino liva mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu. ‘buli Omwoyo wa Mukama w’abeera, wabaawo eddembe.’ ‘bwe muluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo, olwo nga temukyafugibwa mateeka.’ Omutima ogujjudde Omwoyo gufuulibwa ogw’eddembe ddala. Naye tetwafuulibwa ba ddembe tulyoke tukole bye twagala ffe. Nedda, twafuulibwa ba ddembe okugoberera okuluŋŋamya kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. ‘Buli Omwoyo w’abeera, wabaawo eddembe.’

4. Eddembe lino liri mu kwagala. ‘mwayitibwa lwa ddembe, noolwekyo eddembe teribawa bbeetu kugoberera bya mubiri. Naye olw’okwagala buli omu abeerenga muweereza wa munne.’ Eddembe Omwana ly’atuwa bw’atufuula ab’eddembe, lye ddembe ery’okufaanana nga ye, okwagala n’okuweereza. ‘newaakubadde nga ndi wa ddembe eri abantu bonna, nfuuka omuddu wa bonna olw’okweyagalira, ndyoke ndeete bangi eri Kristo.’ Lino lye ddembe ery’okwagala.

5. ‘Noolwekyo mwasumululwa okuva mu kibi, ne mufuuka baddu ba butuukirivu, okutuuka ku kutukuzibwa.’ ‘Leka abantu bange bagende, balyoke bansinze.’ Omuntu akola eby’obutuukirivu yekka y’ayinza okufuuka omutukuvu.

6. Eddembe lino kintu kya ssanyu n’okuyimba.

7. Eddembe lino lye musingi gw’obutukuvu. Omununuzi atufuula ab’eddembe ye Katonda, Omutukuvu. Nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu, y’atuluŋŋamya okulifuna mu bujjuvu. Okuba ow’eddembe ennyo okuva ku buli kintu, Katonda alyoke asobole okukutwala yenna, kwe kuba omutukuvu.


Olunaku olw’Amakumi Abiri mu Lumu.

Tetulina kubikendeeza ne tubiwa amakulu amatono, wadde okubiyingizaamu amakulu amangi okusinga Omwoyo Omutukuvu ge yagenderera wano. Pawulo tayogera ku kubalirwa, wadde ku kintu omuntu ky’awulira. Tetulina kukikomya ku kusumululwa okuva mu kikolimo oba mu kibonerezo ky’ekibi. Ebigambo ebikyetoolodde biraga nti ayogera, si ku mbeera yaffe mu maaso g’omulamuzi, wabula ku kintu eky’amazima eky’omwoyo: okubeera kwaffe mu kwegatta okulamu ne Kristo mu kufa kwe ne mu kuzuukira kwe, era bwe tutyo okuggibwa ddala wansi w’obufuzi oba obuyinza bw’ekibi. ‘Ekibi tekiribafuga.’ Era tannayogera ku kintu ekiwulirwa, nti tuwulira nga tuli ba ddembe okuva mu kibi kyonna. Ayogera ku kintu ekinene ekiriwo ddala: Kristo okutununula olw’enkomerero okuva mu buyinza ekibi bwe kyalina okutukaka okukola bye kyagala n’emirimu gyakyo; era atukubiriza, mu kukkiriza ekintu kino eky’ekitalo, okugaana n’obuvumu okuwuliriza ebiragiro oba okukema kw’ekibi. Okumanya eddembe lye tulina mu Kristo, okusumululwa kwaffe okuva mu bufuzi n’obuyinza bw’ekibi, lye kkubo ery’okulifuula ekintu kye tulaba mu bulamu bwaffe. Mu biseera eby’edda, Abatuluki oba Abawalabu bwe baafuulanga Abakristaayo abaddu emirundi mingi, ensimbi nnyingi zaasasulwanga okununula abo abaali mu buddu. Naye kyabaawo emirundi egisukka mu gumu, ewala munda mu nsi y’abaddu, abaanunulibwa obutawulira ku mawulire ago; bakama baabwe baasanyukanga nnyo okubakisa. Abalala nabo baawulira amawulire, naye baali bamaze okumanyiira obuddu bwabwe, ne batasobola kwekunkumula kufuba kutuuka ku lubalama lw’ennyanja. Obugayaavu oba okuggwamu essuubi ne bibakuumira mu buddu; tebaasobola kukkiriza nti bandisobodde okutuuka emirembe mu nsi ey’eddembe. Ensimbi ez’okubanunula zaali zisasuddwa; mu mazima baali ba ddembe; naye mu bulamu bwabwe, olw’obutamanya oba olw’obutaba na buvumu, baali bakyali mu buddu. Okununulibwa kwa Kristo kumalirawo ddala ekibi n’obuyinza obw’amateeka bwe kyalina ku ffe,—kubanga ‘amaanyi g’ekibi gava mu mateeka,’—ne kiba nti mu bikolwa ddala, mu mazima agasingayo obuziba, ekibi tekirina buyinza kutukaka kukigondera. Kisobola okutufuga lwokka nga tukikkirizza okuddamu okufuga, nga tweweerayo nate okuba abaddu baakyo. Setaani akola kyonna ky’asobola okukuuma abakkiriza mu butamanya bwa ddembe lino lyabwe nga bwe lijjuvu okuva mu buddu bwe. Era olw’okuba abakkiriza bamativu nnyo n’ebirowoozo byabwe bo bennyini ku makulu g’okununulibwa, ne beegomba katono era ne basaba katono okukulaba n’okukufuna mu bujjuvu bwakwo obw’okununulibwa n’omukisa, okumanya kwabwe mu bulamu eddembe okuva mu kibi gye liyinza okutuukira kye kiva kunafuye bwe kutyo. ‘buli Omwoyo wa Mukama w’abeera, wabaawo eddembe.’ Eddembe lino lifuuka lyaffe ku bw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, olw’ekitangaala kye n’okuluŋŋamya kwe munda mu ffe, bwe tubirindirira n’obwetoowaze ne tubigondera. Mu ssuula ey’omukaaga Pawulo ayogera ku ddembe okuva mu kibi, ne mu ssuula 7 (nny. 3, 4, 6) ku ddembe okuva mu mateeka, nti byombi byaffe mu Kristo ne mu kwegatta naye. Mu ssuula 8 (nny. 2) ayogera ku ddembe lino ng’eryafuuka eryaffe mu bulamu bwe tuyitamu. Agamba nti, ‘etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo Yesu, lyannunula okuva mu tteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa.’ Eddembe eriri eryaffe mu Kristo lirina okufuuka eryaffe ku bwaffe, mu kulyetwalira n’okulinyumirwa, ku bw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Eky’okubiri kyesigamye ku kisooka: okukkiriza gye kukoma okujjula, okutegeera gye kukoma okulongooka, okwenyumiriza mu Kristo Yesu ne mu ddembe lye yatufuula ab’eddembe gye kukoma okuwangula, n’okuyingira mu ddembe ery’ekitiibwa ery’abaana ba Katonda gye kukoma okwanguwa n’okujjula. Nga eddembe bwe liri mu Kristo yekka, bwe kityo Omwoyo wa Kristo yekka y’alifuula eryaffe mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, era y’atukuuma nga tubeera omwo: ‘etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo Yesu, lyannunula okuva mu tteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa.’ ‘buli Omwoyo wa Mukama w’abeera, wabaawo eddembe.’ Omwoyo bw’atubikkulira Yesu nga ye Mukama era Mukulu waffe, Mukulu waffe omuggya, oyo yekka alina obuyinza ku ffe, n’atuluŋŋamya okwewaayo, okuwaayo ebitundu byaffe, n’okuwaayo obulamu bwaffe bwonna okuweereza Katonda mu Kristo, okukkiriza kwaffe mu ddembe okuva mu kibi kufuuka ekintu kye tumanyi era kye tulaba. Bw’akkiriza nti okununulibwa kujjuvu, omusibe afuluma nga ‘ow’eddembe owa Mukama.’ Kaakano amanyi nti ekibi tekikyalina buyinza, wadde akaseera akamu, okumulagira okukigondera. Kiyinza okugezaako okukakasa obuyinza bwakyo obw’edda; kiyinza okwogera mu ddoboozi ery’obuyinza; kiyinza okututiisa ne tugonda; naye obuyinza ku ffe tekirina n’akatono, okuggyako nga ffe, nga twerabidde eddembe lyaffe, tugondera okukema kwakyo, ne tukiwa ffe bennyini obuyinza. Tuli ba ddembe aba Mukama. ‘Tulina eddembe lyaffe mu Kristo Yesu.’ Mu Abaruumi 7 Pawulo annyonnyola okulwana okw’entiisa okw’emmeeme ekyagezaako okutuukiriza amateeka, naye n’eyeesanga nga teyeesobola n’akatono; ng’etundiddwa wansi w’ekibi, omusibe era omuddu, nga terina ddembe kukola omutima gwonna bye gwegomba. Naye Omwoyo bw’atwala ekifo ky’amateeka, okwemulugunya nti, ‘Nga ndi muntu munaku!’ kukyuka ne kufuuka oluyimba olw’obuwanguzi: ‘Katonda yeebazibwe mu Yesu Kristo; etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu lyannunula.’ Okwemulugunya okutabalika okw’amaanyi agatamala okukola Katonda by’ayagala, okw’okufuba okutavaamu kantu n’essuubi eryamenyeka, n’okw’okulemererwa obutayosa, kuddamu mu ngeri nkumi na nkumi okwemulugunya kw’omusibe nti, ‘Nga ndi muntu munaku!’ Katonda yeebazibwe! Waliwo okununulibwa. ‘Kale nga Kristo bwe yatufuula ab’eddembe, bwe mutyo munywerere mu ddembe eryo muleme kusibwa nate mu kikoligo ky’obuddu.’ Setaani bulijjo anoonya okututeekako nate ekikoligo, oba eky’ekibi oba eky’amateeka, okuzaala nate omwoyo ogw’obuddu, ng’ekibi oba amateeka n’ebyo bye biragira birina obuyinza ku ffe mu ngeri emu oba endala. Si bwe kiri: temukkiriza kusibwa nate; munywerere mu ddembe Kristo lye yabafuula ab’eddembe. Ka tuwulirize obubaka buno: ‘mwasumululwa okuva mu kibi, ne mufuuka baddu ba butuukirivu; bwe mutyo muweeyo ebitundu byammwe eby’omubiri okuba abaddu b’obutuukirivu, mube batukuvu.’ ‘mwasumululwa mu kibi, ne mufuuka baddu ba Katonda, ebivaamu bibatuusa ku kutukuzibwa.’ Okuba omutukuvu, olina okuba ow’eddembe, ow’eddembe ddala ddala; ow’eddembe Yesu akufuge, akuluŋŋamye; ow’eddembe Omwoyo Omutukuvu akukozese nga bw’ayagala, akufuuweemu omukka gwe, akole omulimu gwe ogw’ekyama, omuteefu, naye ogw’amaanyi, olyoke okule okutuuka mu ddembe lyonna Yesu lye yakuwangulira. Yeekaalu teyandisobodde kutukuzibwa olwa Katonda okugibeeramu, okuggyako nga teriiko mukama mulala yenna era nga tekozesebwa mulimu mulala gwonna, ebe yiye yekka n’okumuweereza kwokka. Yeekaalu ey’omunda ey’omutima gwaffe teyinza kutukuzibwa ddala mu bujjuvu, okuggyako nga tuli ba ddembe okuva ku buli mukama omulala na buli buyinza, okuva ku buli kikoligo ky’obuddu, oba ky’okutya, oba ky’okubuusabuusa, Omwoyo we alyoke atuluŋŋamye mu ddembe erituukiridde eribala ekibala ky’obutukuvu obw’amazima. Bwe mwasumululwa okuva mu kibi, ne mufuuka baddu ba butuukirivu, mulina ebibala byammwe ebituusa ku butukuvu, n’enkomerero bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo. Eddembe, Obutuukirivu, Obutukuvu—gano ge madaala mu kkubo erigenda eri ekitiibwa ekijja. Gye tukoma okuyingira mu buziba n’okukkiriza mu ddembe lyaffe lye tulina mu Kristo, gye tukoma okuwaayo ebitundu byaffe eri Katonda n’essanyu n’obuvumu ng’ebikozesebwa eby’obutuukirivu. Katonda ye Kitaffe, gwe tusanyukira okukola by’ayagala, era okumuweereza lye ddembe erituukiridde. Omununuzi ye Mukama waffe, okwagala gwe kutusiba gy’ali mu buwulize obw’okweyagalira. Eddembe si kubeera awatali tteeka: ‘twalokolebwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe, tulyoke tumuweereze mu butuukirivu ne mu butukuvu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe.’ Eddembe kye kisaanyizo ky’obutuukirivu; n’obutuukirivu nabwo kye kisaanyizo ky’obutukuvu. Okukola Katonda by’ayagala kutuyingiza mu kussa kimu okwo, mu kukwatagana kw’omutima ne Katonda yennyini, omuva ekifaananyi ky’Okubeerawo kwa Katonda ekyakaayakana, kwe kugamba Obutukuvu. Bwe tusumululwa okuva mu kibi, ne tufuulibwa abaddu b’obutuukirivu era aba Katonda, tulina ebibala byaffe ebituusa ku butukuvu, n’enkomerero—ekibala ky’obutukuvu, bwe kyengera, kifuuka ensigo y’—obulamu obutaggwaawo. Mubenga batukuvu, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu. Ai Katonda ow’ekitiibwa ekisingirayo ddala! Nkwegayirira ozibule amaaso gange ndabe eddembe lino ery’ekitalo Kristo lye yanfuula ow’eddembe. Ka nnyingire mu bujjuvu mu kigambo kyo, nti ekibi tekiriba na buyinza ku nze kubanga sifugibwa mateeka wabula ekisa. Ka mmanye eddembe lyange lye nnina mu Kristo Yesu, era nnywerere omwo. Kitaffe! Okukuweereza lye ddembe erituukiridde: kino nakyo kimbikkulire. Ggwe oli wa Ddembe atalina kkomo, era by’oyagala tebiriiko kkomo okuggyako eryo okutuukirira kwabyo kwennyini lye kwateekawo. Era otuyita okuyingira mu by’oyagala, tulyoke tubeere ba ddembe nga ggwe bw’oli. Ai Katonda wange! Ndaga obulungi bw’ebyo by’oyagala, nga bwe binsumulula okuva mu nze kennyini n’okuva mu kibi, era bibeere omukisa gwange gwokka. Okuweereza obutuukirivu kubeere gye ndi essanyu n’amaanyi, nga kubala ebibala ebituusa ku kutukuzibwa, nga kunnyingiza mu Butukuvu bwo. Mukama Yesu Omutendereze! Omununuzi wange era Eddembe lyange, ndi wuwo. Nneewaayo eri by’oyagala, nneme kumanya kye njagala okuggyako ky’oyagala. Mukama wange! Ggwe, era ggwe wekka, gwe njagala okuweereza. Eddembe lyange liri mu ggwe! Beera Mukuumi wange. Siyinza kuyimirira wadde akaseera akamu nga siri mu ggwe. Mu ggwe nsobola okunywerera: mu ggwe mwe nteeka obwesige bwange. Ai Katonda Omutukuvu ennyo! Nga ndi mwana wo ow’eddembe, omuwulize, era akwagala, ojja kunfuula omutukuvu. Amiina. 1. Eddembe bwe buyinza okukola awatali kiziyiza ekyo obutonde bwaffe kye butusindiikiriza okukola. Mu Kristo omwana wa Katonda wa ddembe okuva ku buli buyinza obuyinza okumuziyiza okukola ng’etteeka ly’obutonde bwe obuggya bwe liragira. 2. Eddembe lino liva mu kukkiriza (Abaggalatiya 5:5-6). Olw’okukkiriza Kristo nnyingira mu lyo, era nnyimirira mu lyo. 3. Eddembe lino liva mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu. ‘buli Omwoyo wa Mukama w’abeera, wabaawo eddembe.’ ‘bwe muluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo, olwo nga temukyafugibwa mateeka.’ Omutima ogujjudde Omwoyo gufuulibwa ogw’eddembe ddala. Naye tetwafuulibwa ba ddembe tulyoke tukole bye twagala ffe. Nedda, twafuulibwa ba ddembe okugoberera okuluŋŋamya kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. ‘Buli Omwoyo w’abeera, wabaawo eddembe.’ 4. Eddembe lino liri mu kwagala. ‘mwayitibwa lwa ddembe, noolwekyo eddembe teribawa bbeetu kugoberera bya mubiri. Naye olw’okwagala buli omu abeerenga muweereza wa munne.’ Eddembe Omwana ly’atuwa bw’atufuula ab’eddembe, lye ddembe ery’okufaanana nga ye, okwagala n’okuweereza. ‘newaakubadde nga ndi wa ddembe eri abantu bonna, nfuuka omuddu wa bonna olw’okweyagalira, ndyoke ndeete bangi eri Kristo.’ Lino lye ddembe ery’okwagala. 5. ‘Noolwekyo mwasumululwa okuva mu kibi, ne mufuuka baddu ba butuukirivu, okutuuka ku kutukuzibwa.’ ‘Leka abantu bange bagende, balyoke bansinze.’ Omuntu akola eby’obutuukirivu yekka y’ayinza okufuuka omutukuvu. 6. Eddembe lino kintu kya ssanyu n’okuyimba. 7. Eddembe lino lye musingi gw’obutukuvu. Omununuzi atufuula ab’eddembe ye Katonda, Omutukuvu. Nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu, y’atuluŋŋamya okulifuna mu bujjuvu. Okuba ow’eddembe ennyo okuva ku buli kintu, Katonda alyoke asobole okukutwala yenna, kwe kuba omutukuvu. Olunaku olw’Amakumi Abiri mu Lumu.

fields.title: Obutukuvu n’Essanyu
fields.body_html:
‘Obwakabaka bwa Katonda bwe ssanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.’—Abaruumi 14:17.

‘Abayigirizwa ne bajjula essanyu ne Mwoyo Mutukuvu.’—Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:52.

‘Nekkemiya n’abagamba nti, Leero lunaku lutukuvu eri Mukama, temunakuwala, kubanga essanyu eriva eri Mukama ge maanyi gammwe. Awo Abaleevi ne bakkakkanya abantu bonna, nga boogera nti, Mubeere bakkakkamu kubanga leero lunaku lutukuvu. Temunakuwala. Oluvannyuma abantu bonna ne beddirayo ewaabwe, ne basanyuka nnyo, kubanga baategeera amakulu g’ebigambo ebyabategeezebwa.’—Nekkemiya 8:10-12.

Amakulu amazito ag’essanyu mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo tegatera kutegeerwa. Emirundi mingi essanyu litwalibwa ng’ekintu eky’okubiri; so nga okubeerawo kwalyo kwetaagisa nnyo, kubanga kwe kukakasa nti Katonda ddala atumala, era nti okumuweereza kye kitusanyusa. Mu bulamu bw’awaka tetumatira olw’okuba nti empisa ennungi zonna zigobererwa, era nti buli omu atuukiriza obuvunaanyizibwa bwe eri munne; okwagala okwa nnamaddala kwe kutuleetera okusanyukirana; okwagala bwe kufulumya ebbugumu lyakwo ery’omukwano, essanyu lye musana ogujjuza amaka ekitangaala kyagwo. Ne mu kubonaabona oba mu bwavu, ab’omu maka abaagalana basanyusa bannaabwe. Okusingira ddala, awatali ssanyu lino, tewali buwulize bwa nnamaddala ku ludda lw’abaana. Omuzadde tatunuulira kutuukiriza kiragiro kyokka, oba okukola omulimu; wabula omwoyo ogwagala, ogw’essanyu era ogwanguwa, omulimu gwe gukolebwamu, gwe gugufuula ogusanyusa.

Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne mu nkolagana y’abaana ba Katonda ne Kitaabwe. Ne bwe tuba nga tufuba okubeera mu bulamu obw’okwewaayo n’obuwulize obw’enjiri, bulijjo tuba mu kabi ak’okuddamu okugwa wansi w’amateeka, n’ekigambo kyago nti, Oteekwa. Ekivaamu bulijjo kwe kulemererwa. Amateeka galeeta busungu bwokka; tegawa bulamu wadde amaanyi. Kye kiseera kyokka bwe tuba nga tuyimiridde mu ssanyu lya Mukama waffe, mu ssanyu ly’okununulibwa okuva mu kibi, mu ssanyu ly’okwagala kwe ne mu ekyo ky’ali gye tuli, mu ssanyu ly’okubeerawo kwe, lwe tuba n’amaanyi okuweereza n’okugondera. Bwe tumala okufuulibwa ab’eddembe okuva eri buli mukama, eri ekibi n’okwerowoozaako n’amateeka, era nga tusanyukira eddembe lino, olwo lwokka lwe tuba n’amaanyi okuweereza mu ngeri ematiza Katonda era ematiza naffe. ‘Ndiddamu okubalaba,’ Yesu bwe yagamba, ‘ne musanyuka, era essanyu lyammwe tewali n’omu aliribaggyako.’ Essanyu bwe bujulizi era ye mbeera y’okubeerawo kwa Yesu yennyini okw’olubeerera.

Obanga obutukuvu bwe bulungi era ekitiibwa eky’obulamu obw’okukkiriza, kyeyoleka lwatu nti wano okusinga wonna essanyu teriyinza kubulawo. Tumaze okulaba nga omulundi ogwasooka Katonda okwogerwako ng’Omutukuvu gwali mu luyimba olw’okutendereza ku lubalama lw’Ennyanja Emyufu; nga Kaana ne Maliyamu, mu biseera byabwe eby’okuluŋŋamizibwa, bwe baatendereza Katonda ng’Omutukuvu; nga erinnya ly’Omutukuvu Emirundi Esatu mu ggulu bwe lituuka gye tuli mu luyimba lwa basseraafi; era nga mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka, ebiramu n’ekibiina ekiwangudde ekiyimba oluyimba lw’Omwana gw’Endiga, bwe bisinza Katonda ng’Omutukuvu. Tulagirwa nti, ‘musinze Mukama mu kitiibwa eky’obutukuvu bwe,’ era ‘okuyimba nga tutendereza erinnya lye ettukuvu;’ mu mwoyo gw’okusinza n’okutendereza n’essanyu mwokka mwe tuyinza okumanya Katonda mu bujjuvu ng’omutukuvu. Okusinga ennyo, mu kuluŋŋamizibwa kw’okwagala okusinza n’essanyu mwokka mwe tuyinza ffe ffennyini okufuulibwa abatukuvu. Bwe tulekeraawo okutya kwonna n’okweraliikirira, okwekaka kwonna n’okufuba, ne tuwummulira mu kuyimba mu ekyo Yesu ky’ali mu mulimu gwe gwe yamaliriza ng’okutukuzibwa kwaffe, bwe tuwummula ne tusanyukira mu ye, olwo lwe tulifuuka abagabana ku Butukuvu bwe. Olunaku lw’okuwummula lwe lunaku Katonda lwe yawa omukisa, olunaku olw’omukisa n’essanyu; era olunaku lwe yawa omukisa lwe lunaku lwe olutukuvu. Obutukuvu n’okuba n’omukisa tebiyinza kwawukana.

Naye kino tekikontana na kuyigiriza kw’Ebyawandiikibwa n’ebyo abatukuvu bye bayiseemu? Okubonaabona n’ennaku si bye bimu ku bintu Katonda bye yalonda okututukuza? Ebisuubizo si by’abo abamenyese emitima, abaavu mu mwoyo, n’abakungubaga? Okwefiiriza n’okuleka byonna bye tulina, okukomererwa ne Kristo n’okufa buli lunaku, si lye kkubo erituusa ku butukuvu? era bino byonna si bya nnaku na bulumi okusinga essanyu n’okujaguza?

Okuddibwamu kunaasangibwa mu kutegeera obulungi obulamu obw’okukkiriza. Okukkiriza kutusitula waggulu, ne kutufuula bannannyini ku ekyo ekikontanira ddala n’ebyo bye tuwulira oba bye tuyitamu. Mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo bulijjo mubaamu ekyewuunyo: ebirabika ng’ebikontana ebitasobola kutabagana bisangibwa wamu mu kaseera ke kamu. Pawulo akyogera mu bigambo bino: ‘ng’abaafa, naye laba nga tuli balamu, nga tunakuwala naye ate nga tusanyuka bulijjo, nga tuli ng’abaavu naye nga tugaggawaza bangi, nga tuli ng’abatalina kintu naye ate nga tulina byonna.’ Ate awalala agamba bw’ati: ‘buli bwe mba omunafu, olwo nga ndi wa maanyi.’ Okukontana kuno okulabika kutabaganyizibwa, si mu kwegatta kw’obulamu obubiri bwokka, obw’obuntu n’obwa Katonda, mu buli mukkiriza, naye okusingira ddala mu ffe okuba, mu kaseera ke kamu, abagabana ku kufa ne ku kuzuukira kwa Kristo. Okufa kwa Kristo kwali kwa bulumi na kubonaabona, okufa okwa nnamaddala era okw’entiisa, okukutulwa kw’enkolagana egatta emmeeme n’omubiri, omwoyo n’ennyama. Amaanyi g’okufa okwo gakolera mu ffe: tuteekwa okugaleka gakole n’amaanyi bwe tuba ab’okubeera abatukuvu; kubanga mu kufa okwo yeetukuza, naffe tulyoke tutukuzibwe mu mazima. Obutukuvu bwaffe, nga obubwe, buli mu kufiira okwagala kwaffe n’obulamu bwaffe bwonna. Naye—kino tuteekwa okufuba okukitegeera—tetusemberera kufa nga tuva ku ludda Kristo kwe yakusisinkana, ng’omulabe ow’okuwangulwa, ng’okubonaabona okw’okugumiikiriza nga tetunnayingira mu bulamu obuggya. Nedda, omukkiriza amanyi Kristo ky’ali ng’Oyo Eyazuukira, asemberera okufa, kwe kugamba okukomerera okwerowoozaako, omubiri n’ensi, ng’ava ku ludda lw’okuzuukira, ekifo eky’obuwanguzi, mu maanyi ga Kristo Omulamu. Bwe twabatizibwa mu Kristo, twabatizibwa mu kufa kwe ne mu kuzuukira kwe nga bibyaffe; era Kristo yennyini, Mukama Omulamu Eyazuukira, atukulembera mu buwanguzi okutuyingiza mu kumanya amaanyi g’okufa kwe. Bwe kityo, eri omukkiriza abeera mu kukkiriza ddala, atanoonya kukomerera na kutta mubiri mu kulwana kwe ye, wabula amanyi Mukama omulamu, essanyu ery’omunda ery’okuzuukira terimuvaako wadde akaseera, wabula ge maanyi ge mu ebyo abalala bye bayinza okulaba ng’okwefiiriza okw’obulumi bwokka n’okwetikka omusaalaba. Agamba ne Pawulo nti, ‘Nneenyumiririza mu musaalaba, olw’ogwo nkomereddwa.’ Takyabuuza, nga bangi bwe bakola, ekibuuzo kya Pawulo nti, ‘Ani alindokola mu mubiri guno ogugenda okufa?’ awatali kuyimba kuddamu okw’essanyu n’obuwanguzi ng’ekintu ky’ayitamu kaakano: ‘Katonda yeebazibwe mu Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe.’ ‘Katonda yeebazibwe atuwanguzisa bulijjo mu Kristo.’ Essanyu ly’Omulokozi Ali Kaakano, ery’okulaba obulokozi obutuukiridde, essanyu ly’obulamu obw’okuzuukira, lyokka lye liwa amaanyi okuyingira mu buziba ne mu bujjuvu mu kufa Kristo kwe yafa, n’okuwaayo okwagala kwaffe n’obulamu bwaffe okutukuzibwa ddala eri Katonda. Mu ssanyu ly’obulamu obwo, amaanyi g’okufa bulijjo mwe gabeera, kisoboka okugamba n’Omutume buli kaseera nti, ‘ng’abaafa, naye laba nga tuli balamu, nga tunakuwala naye ate nga tusanyuka bulijjo.’

Ka tufube okuyiga amasomo gano abiri: Obutukuvu tebwewalika okusobola okuba n’essanyu erya nnamaddala; essanyu teryewalika okusobola okuba n’obutukuvu obwa nnamaddala. Obutukuvu tebwewalika okusobola okuba n’essanyu erya nnamaddala. Bw’oba oyagala essanyu, okujjula kw’essanyu, essanyu ery’olubeerera eritalina kiyinza kulikuggyako, beera mutukuvu nga Katonda bw’ali omutukuvu. Obutukuvu kwe kuba n’omukisa. Tewali kiyinza kuzikiza oba kutaataaganya ssanyu lyaffe okuggyako ekibi. Ka kibe kugezesebwa kwa ngeri ki oba okukemebwa, essanyu lya Yesu, Peetero ly’ayogerako nti, ‘ne mujjula essanyu eritayogerekeka,’ lisobola okubisasula n’okubisinga obuzito. Bwe tufiirwa essanyu lyaffe, kiteekwa okuba ekibi. Kiyinza okuba ekyonoono ekyeyolefu, oba okugoberera okwerowoozaako oba ensi nga tetumanyi; kiyinza okuba ebbala ku mutima gwaffe ogw’omunda olw’ekintu eky’okubuusabuusa, oba kiyinza okuba obutakkiriza obwagala okutambulira mu kulaba, era obulowooza ku bwo bwokka ne ku ssanyu lyabwo okusinga ku Mukama yekka: ka kibe ki, tewali kiyinza kutuggyako ssanyu lyaffe okuggyako ekibi. Bwe tuba twagala okubeera mu bulamu obw’essanyu, nga tukakasa Katonda n’abantu naffe ffennyini nti Mukama waffe ye buli kimu, era nti gye tuli asinga byonna, ayi, ka tubeere abatukuvu! Ka twenyumirize mu ye, ye butukuvu bwaffe: w’ali we wali essanyu erijjuvu. Ka tubeere mu Bwakabaka obuli essanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu; Omwoyo ow’obutukuvu ye Mwoyo ow’essanyu, kubanga ye Mwoyo wa Katonda. Abatukuvu, abantu ba Katonda abatukuvu, be balireekaana olw’essanyu.

Era essanyu teryewalika okusobola okuba n’obutukuvu obwa nnamaddala. Bw’oba oyagala okuba Omukristaayo omutukuvu, oteekwa okuba Omukristaayo omusanyufu. Yesu yafukibwako Katonda ‘amafuta ag’essanyu,’ alyoke atuwe ‘amafuta ag’essanyu.’ Mu kufuba kwaffe kwonna okugoberera obutukuvu, nnamuziga zinaatambula mu buzito bwe watabaawo mafuta ga ssanyu; go gokka ge gaggyawo okwekaka n’okukwataganako okw’amaanyi kwonna, ne gafuula okweyongerayo mu maaso okwangu era okusanyusa. Fuba okutegeera omuwendo gw’essanyu ogwa Katonda. Bwe bujulizi nti oli mu maaso ga Kitaffe, era nti obeera mu kwagala kwe. Kye kikakasa nti omanyi nti oli wa ddembe okuva eri amateeka n’okwekaka kw’omwoyo ogw’obuddu. Kye kabonero nti oli wa ddembe okuva mu kweraliikirira n’obuvunaanyizibwa, kubanga osanyukira mu Kristo Yesu ng’Okutukuzibwa kwo, Omukuumi wo, era Amaanyi go. Kye kyama ky’obulamu obulungi obw’omwoyo n’amaanyi, nga kijjuza obuweereza bwo bwonna obukakafu obw’essanyu obw’omwana omuto nti Kitaffe tasaba kintu ky’atawa maanyi kukikola, era nti akkiriza byonna ebikoleddwa mu mwoyo guno, ne bwe biba nga bikoleddwa mu bunafu. Essanyu erya nnamaddala bulijjo teryerowoozaako: lyebulira mu ekyo ekirisanyusa. Essanyu ly’Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe lituujjuza, ne tusanyukira mu Katonda Omutukuvu, ku bwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, bwe twebulira mu kusinza n’okutendereza Omutukuvu Emirundi Esatu, tufuuka abatukuvu. Lino, ne wano mu ddungu, lye ‘Kkubo Ettukuvu: abantu ba Mukama abaanunulibwa balikomawo nga bayimba; abanunule balitambulira eyo; essanyu ery’emirembe n’emirembe liriba ku mitwe gyabwe; balifuna essanyu n’okujaguza.’

Abaana ba Katonda bonna kino bakitegeera? Nti obutukuvu linnya lirala bulala, era lye linnya ery’amazima, Katonda ly’atuuma essanyu; nti ddala gwe mukisa ogutayogerekeka okumanya nti Katonda ddala atufuula abatukuvu, nti obutukuvu bwaffe buli mu Kristo, nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu owa Kristo ali munda mu ffe. Tewali kisikiriza nga ssanyu: abakkiriza bakitegedde nti lino lye ssanyu lya Mukama—okuba omutukuvu? Oba endowooza ey’okwekaka, n’okwefiiriza, n’okusinda, ey’obuzibu n’obuwanvu, si ye esinze okweyoleka, ne kiba nti ekirowoozo eky’okuba omutukuvu kumpi tekisanyusangako mutima? Obanga bwe kibadde bwe kityo, kireme kuba bwe kityo nate. ‘Mu Mutukuvu wa Isirayiri mw’olyenyumiririza:’ ka twetwalire ekisuubizo kino. Okukakasa okw’okukkiriza nti Kitaffe atwagala, ne Mukama waffe Yesu omwagalwa, n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera munda mu ffe n’obukkakkamu ng’obw’ejjiba, beeyamye okukola omulimu guno, era bagukola, ka kutujjuze essanyu. Tetunoonyanga ssanyu lyaffe mu butukuvu bwe tulaba mu ffe: ka tusanyukire Obutukuvu bwa Katonda mu Kristo ng’obwaffe; ka tusanyukire mu Mutukuvu wa Isirayiri. Bwe kityo essanyu lyaffe liriba eritayogerekeka era eritakoma; bwe tutyo tulimuwa ekitiibwa.

Mubenga batukuvu, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu.

Ayi Katonda Omutendereze ennyo! Nkwegayirira ombikkulire nze n’abaana bo bonna ekyama ky’okusanyukira mu ggwe, Omutukuvu wa Isirayiri.

Olaba obuweereza bungi obw’abaana bo abaagalwa bwe bukyali mu mwoyo ogw’obuddu, era bangi nnyo nga tebannakkiriza nti Ekkubo Ettukuvu lye kkubo lye bayinza okutambuliramu nga bayimba, era nga balifuna essanyu n’okujaguza. Ayi Kitaffe! Yigiriza abaana bo okusanyukira mu ggwe.

Nkusaba okusingira ddala otuyigirize nti, mu bwavu bw’omwoyo obw’amaanyi, mu bwetoowaze ne mu kwenenya ne mu kuba nga tetulina kintu n’akatono, nga tumanyi nti mu ffe temuli butukuvu, tusobola okuyimba olunaku lwonna ku Butukuvu bwo ng’obwaffe, ku kitiibwa kyo ky’otuteekako, naye nga bulijjo kikyali kikyo kyokka. Ayi Kitaffe! Bikkulira ddala abaana bo ekyama eky’omukisa eky’Obwakabaka, kwe kugamba okukkiriza okulaba byonna mu Kristo ne kutalaba kintu mu kwo; okulina ddala byonna mu ye era okubisanyukira; okutalina kintu era okutasanyukira kintu kyonna mu kwo.

Ayi Katonda Omutendereze, mu Kigambo kyo wagamba nti, ‘Abawombeefu balisanyukira mu Mukama nate, n’abeetaaga balisanyukira mu Mutukuvu wa Isirayiri.’ Ayi, tuwe, ku bw’Omwoyo wo Omutukuvu, mu buwombeefu ne mu bwavu bw’omwoyo, okubeera mu Kristo bwe tutyo, Obutukuvu bwe bubeere essanyu lyaffe eryeyongera bulijjo, era mu ggwe wennyini, Omutukuvu wa Isirayiri, tusanyuke olunaku lwonna. Era bonna balabe mu ffe omukisa oguli mu kubeera abatukuvu ba Katonda. Amiina.

1. Ekisinga okuziyiza essanyu mu Katonda kwe kusuubira okusanga mu ffe ekintu eky’okusanyukira. Bwe tutandika okunoonya obutukuvu, bulijjo tusuubira okulaba enkyukakyuka ennene ekoleddwa mu ffe. Bwe tukulemberwa okuyingira mu buziba bw’okukkiriza n’obulamu obw’okukkiriza bwe buli, tutegeera nti, newaakubadde nga tetulaba nkyukakyuka nga bwe twali tusuubira, naye tusobola okusanyuka n’essanyu eritayogerekeka mu ekyo Yesu ky’ali. Kino kye kyama ky’obutukuvu.

2. Essanyu liteekwa okulabirirwa n’okukuzibwa. Okusanyuka kiragiro ekiweebwa emirundi mingi okusinga bwe tumanyi. Kitundu ku buwulize obw’okukkiriza okusanyuka ne bwe tuba nga tetuwulira kusanyuka. Okukkiriza kusanyuka era kuyimba, kubanga Katonda mutukuvu.

3. ‘Bajjula essanyu ne Mwoyo Mutukuvu,’ ‘Obwakabaka bwe ssanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.’ Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Omwoyo wa Yesu Omutendereze, ali munda mu ggwe, ensulo ddala ey’amazzi amalamu, ey’essanyu n’okujaguza. Ayi, fuba okumumanya, oyo abeera mu ggwe, okukutuusaako byonna Yesu by’akuterekedde: aliba mu ggwe Omwoyo ow’okukkiriza era ow’essanyu.

4. Okwagala n’essanyu bulijjo bitambulira wamu. Okwagala, okwefiiriza n’okwerabira ku lw’ab’oluganda n’abo ababula, nga kubeera mu bo, kusanga essanyu lya Katonda. ‘Obwakabaka bwa Katonda bwe ssanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.’


Olunaku olw’Amakumi Abiri mu Bbiri.
fields.body_text: ‘Obwakabaka bwa Katonda bwe ssanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.’—Abaruumi 14:17. ‘Abayigirizwa ne bajjula essanyu ne Mwoyo Mutukuvu.’—Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:52. ‘Nekkemiya n’abagamba nti, Leero lunaku lutukuvu eri Mukama, temunakuwala, kubanga essanyu eriva eri Mukama ge maanyi gammwe. Awo Abaleevi ne bakkakkanya abantu bonna, nga boogera nti, Mubeere bakkakkamu kubanga leero lunaku lutukuvu. Temunakuwala. Oluvannyuma abantu bonna ne beddirayo ewaabwe, ne basanyuka nnyo, kubanga baategeera amakulu g’ebigambo ebyabategeezebwa.’—Nekkemiya 8:10-12. Amakulu amazito ag’essanyu mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo tegatera kutegeerwa. Emirundi mingi essanyu litwalibwa ng’ekintu eky’okubiri; so nga okubeerawo kwalyo kwetaagisa nnyo, kubanga kwe kukakasa nti Katonda ddala atumala, era nti okumuweereza kye kitusanyusa. Mu bulamu bw’awaka tetumatira olw’okuba nti empisa ennungi zonna zigobererwa, era nti buli omu atuukiriza obuvunaanyizibwa bwe eri munne; okwagala okwa nnamaddala kwe kutuleetera okusanyukirana; okwagala bwe kufulumya ebbugumu lyakwo ery’omukwano, essanyu lye musana ogujjuza amaka ekitangaala kyagwo. Ne mu kubonaabona oba mu bwavu, ab’omu maka abaagalana basanyusa bannaabwe. Okusingira ddala, awatali ssanyu lino, tewali buwulize bwa nnamaddala ku ludda lw’abaana. Omuzadde tatunuulira kutuukiriza kiragiro kyokka, oba okukola omulimu; wabula omwoyo ogwagala, ogw’essanyu era ogwanguwa, omulimu gwe gukolebwamu, gwe gugufuula ogusanyusa. Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne mu nkolagana y’abaana ba Katonda ne Kitaabwe. Ne bwe tuba nga tufuba okubeera mu bulamu obw’okwewaayo n’obuwulize obw’enjiri, bulijjo tuba mu kabi ak’okuddamu okugwa wansi w’amateeka, n’ekigambo kyago nti, Oteekwa. Ekivaamu bulijjo kwe kulemererwa. Amateeka galeeta busungu bwokka; tegawa bulamu wadde amaanyi. Kye kiseera kyokka bwe tuba nga tuyimiridde mu ssanyu lya Mukama waffe, mu ssanyu ly’okununulibwa okuva mu kibi, mu ssanyu ly’okwagala kwe ne mu ekyo ky’ali gye tuli, mu ssanyu ly’okubeerawo kwe, lwe tuba n’amaanyi okuweereza n’okugondera. Bwe tumala okufuulibwa ab’eddembe okuva eri buli mukama, eri ekibi n’okwerowoozaako n’amateeka, era nga tusanyukira eddembe lino, olwo lwokka lwe tuba n’amaanyi okuweereza mu ngeri ematiza Katonda era ematiza naffe. ‘Ndiddamu okubalaba,’ Yesu bwe yagamba, ‘ne musanyuka, era essanyu lyammwe tewali n’omu aliribaggyako.’ Essanyu bwe bujulizi era ye mbeera y’okubeerawo kwa Yesu yennyini okw’olubeerera. Obanga obutukuvu bwe bulungi era ekitiibwa eky’obulamu obw’okukkiriza, kyeyoleka lwatu nti wano okusinga wonna essanyu teriyinza kubulawo. Tumaze okulaba nga omulundi ogwasooka Katonda okwogerwako ng’Omutukuvu gwali mu luyimba olw’okutendereza ku lubalama lw’Ennyanja Emyufu; nga Kaana ne Maliyamu, mu biseera byabwe eby’okuluŋŋamizibwa, bwe baatendereza Katonda ng’Omutukuvu; nga erinnya ly’Omutukuvu Emirundi Esatu mu ggulu bwe lituuka gye tuli mu luyimba lwa basseraafi; era nga mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka, ebiramu n’ekibiina ekiwangudde ekiyimba oluyimba lw’Omwana gw’Endiga, bwe bisinza Katonda ng’Omutukuvu. Tulagirwa nti, ‘musinze Mukama mu kitiibwa eky’obutukuvu bwe,’ era ‘okuyimba nga tutendereza erinnya lye ettukuvu;’ mu mwoyo gw’okusinza n’okutendereza n’essanyu mwokka mwe tuyinza okumanya Katonda mu bujjuvu ng’omutukuvu. Okusinga ennyo, mu kuluŋŋamizibwa kw’okwagala okusinza n’essanyu mwokka mwe tuyinza ffe ffennyini okufuulibwa abatukuvu. Bwe tulekeraawo okutya kwonna n’okweraliikirira, okwekaka kwonna n’okufuba, ne tuwummulira mu kuyimba mu ekyo Yesu ky’ali mu mulimu gwe gwe yamaliriza ng’okutukuzibwa kwaffe, bwe tuwummula ne tusanyukira mu ye, olwo lwe tulifuuka abagabana ku Butukuvu bwe. Olunaku lw’okuwummula lwe lunaku Katonda lwe yawa omukisa, olunaku olw’omukisa n’essanyu; era olunaku lwe yawa omukisa lwe lunaku lwe olutukuvu. Obutukuvu n’okuba n’omukisa tebiyinza kwawukana. Ebisuubizo si by’abo abamenyese emitima, abaavu mu mwoyo, n’abakungubaga?
